senses.gloss: m. (סָרַט) [scratcher, scraper,] crab; Cancer, the fourth sign of the Zodiac, corresp. to the Hebrew month of Tammuz.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 20:1">Pesik. R. s. 20</cite> <he>ואחריו מה אתה בורא ס׳</he> and after that, what wilt thou create? Cancer; <he>למפני … כס׳</he> because man (in childhood) grabs out of holes and cracks like a crab; Tanḥ. Haăz. 1 <he>תחלתו חלש כס׳</he> at first man is weak like a crab.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 27-28">Pesik. R. s. 27-28</cite> <he>הס׳ הזה … המים</he> (some ed. <he>הסַרְטוֹן</he>) the crab lives only on what it finds in the water.
